name: 工程专题手册
description_zh: 46 篇工程专题加 2 篇速判页：API 设计、MySQL、DDD、分布式、重构、代码审查、测试生成、根因调试、威胁建模、LLM 应用安全、生产就绪与 SLO、Java/Laravel/CMS 专项、前端设计、架构决策与选型、Spec 驱动开发、任务拆解与项目记忆；附本地路径与行段查找器。全文 MIT，可自由分发。
description_en: 46 engineering topics plus 2 quick-check pages covering API design, databases, DDD, distributed systems, refactoring, code review, test generation, root-cause debugging, threat modeling, LLM app security, production readiness and SLO, language-specific tracks, frontend design, architecture decisions and spec-driven development; MIT licensed and freely redistributable.
examples_zh: 按 @mysql-database 检查这个慢查询和索引设计
用 @threat-modeling 过一遍这个上传接口的信任边界
这堆遗留代码要重构，先按 @refactoring 给个分步方案
补回归测试，要求修复前必须失败，参考 @test-generation
examples_en: Use @mysql-database to review this slow query and index design
Walk the trust boundaries of this upload endpoint with @threat-modeling
Plan a stepwise refactor of this legacy module per @refactoring
Add regression tests that must fail before the fix, per @test-generation
